seo_description: Registration, home collection, sample tracking, turnaround, pathology, radiology and ECG reporting, e-signatures, and business insights in one lab management platform.

fields.hero_title: One lab system, from booking to signed report
fields.hero_lead: Labora brings home collection, sample tracking, reporting, and billing into one patient case, so every team works from the same record and nothing is typed twice.
fields.screen_alt: Labora dashboard with today's cases, turnaround against target, and revenue by center
fields.cards_title: Ten modules that share one patient case
fields.cards_text: Start with what your lab needs today and switch on more as you grow. Every module reads and writes the same record.
fields.why_title: Fewer handoffs, fewer places for work to get lost
fields.why_points:
Patient details entered once and used everywhere
Every tube scanned at each handoff
Turnaround measured against your own targets
Reports signed digitally and sent automatically
Revenue by center, day, and referring doctor
Roles and an audit trail for every change
fields.other_title: Set up for the way your lab works
fields.cta_title: See the whole platform with your own tests
fields.cta_text: A 20-minute walkthrough of the modules your lab would use, set up with your test menu and centers.
